srList.sentence: Materials and Methods Mice Study Twelve-week-old male C57BL6J mice were fed a modified Lieber-DeCarli (LD) liquid diet containing ethanol (ethanol group E1-3, n = 7-10) or the control LD diet in which ethanol was substituted isocalorically by maltose-dextrin (control group C1-3, n = 5-7) for 5 weeks.
